goals.title: Named artifact fidelity

goals.title: Specifications Hub

goals.title: Authoring and links

goals.title: Bounded search and exploration

goals.title: Native test/result integration

goals.title: API CLI MCP parity

goals.title: Authentication privacy isolation
goals.criterion: 401 missing credential,403/404foreign scope, no public backend bypass, redacted logs/export, payload limits and hostile prose tests.

goals.title: Durability recovery migration
goals.criterion: Real persistent reopen plus crash/backup/restore/migration trial; compare IDs/content beforeafter; old/new data contract explicit.

goals.title: Install and desktop delivery
goals.criterion: Fresh install useful journey, local-first no mandatory remote API, update retains data and recoverable previous artifact.

goals.title: Deployment artifact provenance
goals.criterion: Current hosted and installed artifact exact identity, authenticated real path; Q0 isolated readiness does not qualify production.

goals.title: UX accessibility and DX
goals.criterion: Keyboard/focus/labels/contrast assistive audit without captures; no mock data presented as real; documented command starts actual profile.

goals.title: Assurance and security gates
goals.criterion: Run required local gates with explicit coverage denominator/floor; deliberate regression fails; masked Ruff/Python collection fixed if retained.

goals.title: Research and alternatives
goals.criterion: Version-pin manualworkflow, catalog/search, requirements/source links and dependency exploration peers; matched seeded cases plus idiomatic comparisons.

goals.title: Operations and economic ownership
goals.criterion: Restore rehearsal, dependency failure, resource bounds and explicit recurring-job owner; no billed services added; actual hosting cost unknown.

goals.title: Actual beneficiary acceptance
goals.criterion: Unfamiliar authorized user real owned input, recorded task outcome/interventions/feedback, failures retained; fixture pass does not qualify.

goals.title: Full historical parity disposition
goals.criterion: Each retained promise maps accepted goal/current contract/closure proof, or explicit authority for supersession/defer/retire; no silent sunset.

goals.title: Unified trace-to-product evidence bridge
goals.criterion: Real authorized producer and source anchor, semantic causal navigation, exact restart/replay equality and foreign-product negative controls; meaningful actual user outcome.
